{{Quote|This is Captain Shenes of His Imperial Majesty's Star Destroyer ''Fist of the Empire''! We are taking heavy damage. We will keep fighting as long as we can. Any assistance we could receive with these Annihilators would be appreciated. We live to serve the true Emperor!|Captain Shenes|<ref name="Legacy War 5" />}}
'''Shenes''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Empire-in-exile|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] loyal to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]], whom Shenes regarded as the true Emperor. In [[138 ABY]], Shenes commanded the [[Pellaeon-class Star Destroyer|''Pellaeon''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Fist of the Empire]]'' during the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|Battle of Coruscant]]. As the battle progressed, the ''Fist of the Empire'' was suffered heavy damage from [[One Sith|Sith]] [[Annihilator-class starfighter|''Annihilator''-class starfighters]], prompting Shenes to request aid in defeating the enemy ships while the ''Fist of the Empire'' fought for as long as it could. Shortly afterward, the ''Fist of the Empire'' was destroyed by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] starfighters.<ref name="Legacy War 5" />
